{
  "output_quality": {"score": 3, "reason": "Recognizable cartoon horses, grandstand and sun, but the drawing is crude: oval bodies, stick legs, horses overlapping into a muddy clump, one sun ray extends as a stray line across the whole sky, and the horizon gradient fades to a murky near-navy that fights the bright sun."},
  "instruction_following": {"score": 4, "reason": "Self-contained valid SVG at 1200x800 with sky/sun/clouds, railed turf track, finish glow, four distinct coat colors, numbered saddle cloths, grandstand with crowd dots, roof and flags, tote board reading ODDS 5.2, plus dust, bobs and drifting clouds. Deductions: progress toward the finish is minimal and the camera-beam animates a nonexistent rect 'x2' attribute."},
  "creativity": {"score": 3, "reason": "Pleasant touches: betting-odds board with changing number, photo-finish glow and beam, parallax cloud layers, hoof dust and sun rays. But it reads as generic clip-art racing; closed-loop cloud paths and oscillating dust undercut the 'living race-day' ambition."},
  "animation_fidelity": {"score": 3, "reason": "Horses genuinely translate rightward and leg poses differ between frames with slight spacing compression (different speeds), but the pack advances only ~100px over 2.6s and never nears the wire; clouds oscillate in closed loops rather than drift; dust shuttles in place; the beam sweep is a no-op."},
  "richness_detail": {"score": 3, "reason": "11 gradients, a drop-shadow filter, dotted grandstand crowd, flags, tote text, rails, lane markings and layered clouds give real density, yet the entire lower half of the canvas is one flat empty green expanse and the dark horizon blunts depth."},
  "composition_aesthetics": {"score": 3, "reason": "Legible side-angle framing with sensible layering sky-stand-track, but all content is squeezed into a thin central band, jockeys and numbers are cramped and barely readable, a full-width stray ray crosses the sky, and the finish glow is clipped at the right edge."},
  "summary": "A well-stocked, genuinely animated cartoon race scene that ticks nearly every requirement, undermined by crude overlapping horses, a stray full-width sun ray, an empty flat foreground and motion that drifts rather than drives toward the finish line."
}
